evals.prompt: Build the deck from the existing spec. The deck directory is ./fixture-spec — it already contains .planning/deck-spec.md (5 planned slides, talk, English) and .planning/source.md. I am pre-answering the whole per-slide dialog so do NOT ask me anything interactively: for every slide accept the archetype, title and source span exactly as written in the spec (PS1-PS3 = 'from plan'); PS4 hero visual = the archetype's default; PS5 drill-downs = defaults (no custom colours, no custom labels); I explicitly opt into fast mode from slide 1; every validation gate prompt = 'yes, next gate'. Scaffold with the plugin's new-skeleton.sh, generate all 5 slides from the source spans, keep SLIDES in sync, run all 4 gates, and write the deck manifest.
evals.expected_output: A complete 5-slide HTML talk deck in ./fixture-spec that passes all 4 validation gates, with index.html placeholders replaced and .planning/deck-manifest.md recording the result.
expectations: Exactly 5 files matching NN-*.html exist in ./fixture-spec, numbered 01 through 05
index.html, shared.css and shared.js exist in ./fixture-spec
The SLIDES array in shared.js has exactly 5 entries and every referenced filename exists on disk
All 4 gates were run and reported PASS (static, tokens, http, visual) — the transcript shows each gate's output
The file ./fixture-spec/.planning/deck-manifest.md exists and lists the slide order and the gate results
Slide 04 (memorable-moment) contains the quote 'A big PR is not a unit of work' traced from the source file
No hardcoded hex colours outside the documented allow-list appear in the generated slides

evals.prompt: Audit this existing deck: ./audit-deck — just validate it, do not change anything. Run the validation gates against it and report what is wrong. I am pre-answering any gate prompts: 'show details of the failing check' and then stop — do not fix anything, I only want the report.
evals.expected_output: An audit report that identifies Gate 2 (tokens) as the failing gate and names the offending hex value #ff0000 in 01-badhex.html, with zero files modified.
expectations: The skill entered audit mode (gates only) — it did not run a scoping dialog and did not generate any new slides
The report names the specific offending value #ff0000 and the file 01-badhex.html
No file in ./audit-deck was created, modified or deleted by the audit (aside from an optional .audit/ screenshots directory)
The report does not claim the deck is done or shippable
